title: Acid-Base Titration to an Indicator Endpoint
learningGoal: Assemble a burette, seat a filling funnel for conditioning and the NaOH transfer, remove it to the workbench before reading, record initial and final levels as separate evidence, deliver titrant to a persistent indicator endpoint, and calculate analyte molarity.

commonMistakes.when: the burette is filled straight after a water rinse
commonMistakes.message: Residual water dilutes the titrant and biases every trial low.
commonMistakes.recovery: Condition with the titrant itself before filling.

commonMistakes.when: the titration is started without reading the burette
commonMistakes.message: A burette does not start at 0.00 mL, and the delivered volume is a difference of two readings.
commonMistakes.recovery: Read and record the initial level before opening the stopcock.

commonMistakes.when: an overshot endpoint is treated as recoverable
commonMistakes.message: Titrant already delivered cannot be taken back.
commonMistakes.recovery: Record the overshoot and repeat the trial with a fresh aliquot.
